technical.summary: Mixed short-term momentum (RSI rising, supertrend bullish) conflicts with intermediate bearish structure (below 50/200 MAs, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud), creating low-probability swing entry with elevated pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 64 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small to medium amounts, mixed signals
sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no composite signal; market fear (37/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (345), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event 64 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term RSI momentum (9 and 14 rising) combined with supertrend bullish signal and proximity to support (258.69) offers tactical entry for mean-reversion trade in fear-zone opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Intermediate bearish structure (price below 50/200 MAs, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud), crisis-level VIX, unfavorable macro (rising dollar, flat yield curve), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings binary risk in 64 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 64 days combined with macro headwinds (rising dollar, flat yield curve, VIX 345) could trigger sharp reversal below support, invalidating tactical bounce thesis.
